name: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (obourlandforfoodindustriessae) is served under two keys, EGS30AL1C012.CA PE 11.51 and OLFI PE 11.79, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 20.22 percent a year from FY2021 (3.5068e+08) to FY2025 (7.32543e+08), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 4e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (the shares outstanding on the statement file (sharesOutstanding))
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 4e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (the shares outstanding on the statement file (sharesOutstanding))

derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 24.99) to the price on 2026-10-05
